_doc: Ledger 0080: the San Diego freeway on Lake Murray v4's engine (engine lm-v4: engine-july's prep / exporter / spawn builder and San Diego's v021 assembler, as every _lm port). Phase 1 = the line: I 8 eastbound, open (loop false: tools/stage_dummies_blend.py places the grid 45 m in and AC_TIME_0 15 m short of the end, the original's L11 rule). The draft starts from an EMPTY workshop: lm_intake reads the original's final network draft (track.config.json lm_intake.source_data).
_owed: Phase 2 (ledger 0080): 2b the I 5 / SR 52 / SR 163 mainlines, 2c the ramps and their gore merges, 2d the interchange connectors and flyovers; the barriers; dead-end stubs; the whole box with tiered terrain.
_weld_mouths_doc: ledger 0080 phase 2a: weld_mouths is out of the draft. In phase 1 it welded nothing (0 mouths, 0 of 0 fold quads: the line has no fold), and with a network connector it refuses: its layout self-check (_dev) reads an EMPTY yellow block (a one-way carriageway paints no centre line and the track has no YLINE) as shape (0,) against (0, 3) = inf. A shared junction tool, not changed here; owed to its owners (claude/sand-creek-lm-assets). The ramps mouths (2c) need it or a gore tool.
